title: Cuminum cyminum tea for medicinal use
intro: Cuminum cyminum tea is a herbal preparation made from the dried seeds of the cumin plant, commonly known as cumin. It is traditionally used in herbalism for its digestive and aromatic properties. This tea is often consumed to aid in digestion, relieve bloating, and promote the release of gas from the stomach. It may also support respiratory health by helping to clear mucus and soothe coughs. In many cultures, it is used as a natural remedy for improving overall gastrointestinal function.
